Suppose that $A$ is a $12\times12$ matrix and that, for some vector $\bvec$, the equation $A\xvec=\bvec$ has a unique solution.

What can you say about the pivot positions of $A$?

What can you say about the span of the columns of $A$?

If $\cvec$ is some other vector in $\real^{12}$, what can you conclude about the equation $A\xvec = \cvec$?

What can you say about the solution space to the equation $A\xvec =\zerovec$?
